notes: Second run of 2026-08-28. Seven items queued, all seven read. This feed reaches us through the Chronicle's Bluesky account, and two properties of that make it unpublishable as it stands: the item's title is the social post's teaser sentence rather than the article's headline, and the link is a bit.ly shortlink. The headline is the only text of theirs that reaches a page, so a teaser cannot stand in for it, and a shortlink is not a citation anyone can check. The canonical sfchronicle.com URLs are recorded on each finding below, resolved from the shortlinks with the tracking parameters stripped; the headlines still have to come from the articles themselves before any of these can be published.

The deal expands the company's San Francisco footprint more than sevenfold from about 25,000 square feet.
